firmographics.name: Nimbus Health
firmographics.description: Virtual care platform connecting patients with clinicians across all 50 states.

documents.title: Company — Nimbus Health
documents.snippet: Nimbus Health employs 880 people and serves patients across all 50 states through its virtual care platform.
documents.body: Nimbus Health is a virtual care platform headquartered in Boston. The company employs 880 people and connects patients with licensed clinicians across all 50 states.

documents.title: Nimbus Health closes $120M Series C
documents.snippet: Nimbus Health closed a $120M Series C in April 2026 to scale its commercial organization.
documents.body: Nimbus Health announced a $120M Series C in April 2026. The company said the round will fund scaling its commercial and revenue organization as it moves upmarket toward enterprise health systems.

documents.title: Nimbus Health names new Chief Revenue Officer
documents.snippet: Nimbus Health appointed former Veeva executive Rachel Adler as Chief Revenue Officer in April 2026.
documents.body: Nimbus Health appointed Rachel Adler, previously a commercial leader at Veeva, as Chief Revenue Officer in April 2026. Adler is tasked with building a repeatable enterprise go-to-market motion.

documents.title: 2025 in review
documents.snippet: Nimbus Health reported 130% net revenue retention in 2025, driven by expansion within enterprise health systems.
documents.body: Nimbus Health reported 130% net revenue retention for 2025. The company attributes the result to expansion within existing enterprise health-system accounts and notes growing reliance on product-usage signals to time those expansions.
